mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_log (task_id, action, from_status, to_status, operator_id, operator_name, operator_role, note) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{action}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{operatorRole}, #{note})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, action, from_status, to_status, operator_id, operator_name, operator_role, note, create_time FROM task_log WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY id
